description: Source code for a V4L2 AV1 video decoder delegate handling AV1 picture creation, decoding submission, and output within Chromium's media GPU V4L2 interface.

classes.name: V4L2AV1Picture
classes.description: Represents an AV1 picture with an associated decode surface, supporting duplication and access to the decode surface.

classes.name: V4L2VideoDecoderDelegateAV1
classes.description: Handles AV1 decoding operations, including creating pictures, submitting decode jobs, and outputting pictures within the Chromium media GPU V4L2 framework.

methods.name: CreateAV1Picture
methods.description: Creates a new AV1 picture with an associated decode surface.

methods.name: SubmitDecode
methods.description: Submits an AV1 picture for decoding, setting up necessary controls and buffers.

methods.name: OutputPicture
methods.description: Outputs a decoded AV1 picture, signaling that it is ready for display.
